title: Elsa C Probable NDE 13174
content: I felt ill while driving. I called medics and was admitted to the hospital. Later that evening, I sat down and was unable to get up. Then I began to act irrationally. Next, I became aware of a wall passing by with pictures on it. I realized that I was on a gurney; however, I also realized I was not in my body. I was hovering over it. I felt a lightness I'd never felt before. I also felt relief from all life's problems and responsibilities. I was happy that I had finished all my will documents. Everything had worked out well. I had never felt so at peace. I thought I might have had a stroke or that I might die soon, but it did not trouble me. Next, I saw myself being slid off the gurney and onto a cat scan table. The people sliding me paid no attention to me. They did not know I could see them. I think they talked with one another briefly. Then, I was sitting up on my hospital bed. A nurse was to my right, and using her arms a lot. She spoke to me, although her language made no sense. There were a number of people at the foot of my bed staring at me. They were shrouded in black, although one figure in front had a visible face. She had black hair and round, black glasses. All the people looked so concerned and well-meaning. The nurse continued to gesture to me and seemed to want me to answer questions. I tried to speak to her, but my language was nonsensical like hers. It was very amusing. I quickly gave up trying to speak to her. Later, I was still on the bed. I saw myself slip into my body from the back and heard a loud swish sound. A nurse was there, and I told her I felt fine. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 11/17/2024 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Life threatening event, but not clinical death Very low blood pressure How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I just saw the surrounding near me. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I felt very clear-headed I think considering what was happening. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? During the entire experience. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. There didn't seem to be any time. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I don't remember a lot prior to the experience. I had felt very ill when calling 911. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. My hearing was normal. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Elation. I felt free of all earthly concerns. Relaxed. Happy. Relieved. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No. I recalled being outside my attorney's office and feeling relief that I had finished the paperwork. Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Catholic I don't practice much Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I know I can comfort myself if I pray now. What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes. I believed you had to suffer in order to die. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Uncertain. At first, I was pretty sure I had not died; but at the same time I was aware that I was no longer in my body. Being out of body felt fairly permanent. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes Difficultly putting my affairs in order for my loved ones. During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I had my brother give details of his two near-death experiences. I knew he wasn't lying. I also heard of my brother-in-law's experience of seeing my father in their house the evening of his death. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I knew I had experienced it. I had not dreamed it. I had no doubt about it. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? I have felt very tearful often afterwards. I finally realized that I am sad that I could not go and not come back. It still makes me angry. kgrbmsu_nde

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Slipped back into her body from the back and heard a loud 'swish' sound.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Very low blood pressure; felt ill while driving; hospitalized; later became unable to get up and acted irrationally.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional perceptions within hospital (gurney/CT scan/bed) and re-entry into body with 'swish' sound; no tunnel, light, beings, or boundary.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with hospital observations, then later re-entered body; no tunnel/arrival realm/boundary described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived a wall passing by with pictures while on a gurney; later perceived nurse speaking nonsensical language and shrouded-in-black concerned figures at the foot of the bed; re-entry described as slipping into body from the back with a loud swish; afterward felt tearful/angry about having to come back.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was hovering over it. I felt a lightness I'd never felt before.” “I had never felt so at peace.” “I saw myself slip into my body from the back and heard a loud swish sound.” “I am sad that I could not go and not come back. It still makes me angry.”
